headline: Swedish broadcaster TV4 denies that an AI agent deleted the finished second season of the reality show The Challenge Sverige and blames human error and a failed backup.
score_reason: Follow-up that repeats facts from the 16 Oct 2026 edition with little new, so the pool score of 3 is lowered by 1.
importance_line: It affects the show's crew and viewers, who now wait until next year for the season, and anyone asking whether AI agents can be trusted with server access, but the AI claim is denied and unproven.
summary: Swedish newspaper Aftonbladet reports, as relayed by Mashable, that broadcaster TV4 now rejects the paper's earlier report, carried in our 16 Oct 2026 edition, that production company Mastiff gave an AI agent access to its servers and it deleted the edited second season of the reality show The Challenge Sverige; TV4 programme director Mia Lindqvist said an investigation found human error and a failed backup, with no AI involved. The show's spokesperson confirmed that the files disappeared and that the premiere has moved from 22 Nov to some time next year, but would say only that there was a technical breakdown.
notes: Reply story: TV4 answers Aftonbladet's earlier report, which we ran on 16 Oct 2026 (entry 103). Original reporter is Aftonbladet; the url is Mashable's relay, where the text was read.
